raids.raidLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (a boulder with opinions about where you're walking, a soft green glow under the water, something wearing a crown of bone, bellowing at the dusk, the absence of sound, shaped like wings) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.
